schema.description:
A definite property by which an object can be compared as larger or smaller than other objects of the same physical quantity. 

It is defined and adopted by convention or by law, that is used as a standard for measurement of the same physical quantity.

Any other value of the physical quantity can be expressed as a simple multiple of the Unit of Measure.

conversion_factor_c.description:
Conversion Factor C from the formula for mapping a unit dictionary to the Energistics Unit Of Measure Dictionary.

y=(A+Bx)/(C+Dx)

See Chapter 4, Mapping, in the Energistics Usage Guide:
www.energistics.org/sites/default/files/2023-03/Energistics_Unit_of_Measure_Usage_Guide_V1.pdf.
